business_problem: When you ask Microsoft to get engaged, you can make real progress." No cloud left behind Because one of its core applications—insurance industry stalwart Guidewire—had a multicast networking feature, Hastings Direct needed a cloud solution capable of handling that functionality.
solution_summary: Hastings Direct used Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Cosmos DB to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Where generative AI is involved, Azure OpenAI handles the language understanding layer while connected data and workflow services keep responses grounded in enterprise context. It also connects with surrounding systems such as Call-center telephony, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. To improve its market share and deliver better, faster customer journeys, the company moved its workloads to Microsoft Azure VMware Solution.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Foundry
solution_components.role: Provides the managed environment for model orchestration, experimentation, and responsible AI operations.

solution_components.name: Azure Cosmos DB
solution_components.role: Persists low-latency application data, conversation state, or operational records.

solution_components.name: Azure Kubernetes Service
solution_components.role: Hosts scalable APIs, microservices, and model-serving workloads in containers.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics to business users.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in the application data layer, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure Cosmos DB, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
